name: traceability
title_zh: 代码里埋了 trace:v1 标记
tagline_zh: 改一行需求，最怕漏掉三个调用点和两个测试。它把 trace:v1 标记。
tagline_en: Change one requirement and you risk missing three call sites and two tests. It links trace:v1 markers, .trace/.
desc_en: Repository traceability for TraceLayer (trace:v1 markers, .trace/ config, trace CLI). Use when implementing a spec, requirement, issue, work item, or plan; modifying code or config containing trace:v1 markers; changing a requirement, PRD, ADR, or plan that has downstream traces; creating, deleting, or refactoring traced symbols; adding or removing verification tests; changing deployment/config/run
why_zh: 不是靠语义猜依赖，而是读你亲手埋的 trace:v1 标记做确定性追溯——标记没写的地方。
why_en: Deterministic tracing off the trace:v1 markers you planted yourself, not semantic guesswork. Where no marker exists, it won't.
limit_zh: 只对已经埋了 trace:v1 标记的仓库有效；标记缺失或写错的代码它追不到，也不会替你补标。只覆盖标记声明的链路。
limit_en: Only works on repos already carrying trace:v1 markers; unmarked or mis-marked code is invisible and it won't add markers for you. Covers only.
title_en: Keeps trace:v1 markers in sync with every downstream change
